A football structure dating to 1928 plus the 2006 participation footprint support durable popularity; no France-level popularity evidence is inherited. The 1–10 value is project-authored; missing professional evidence is never converted to zero.

squash_access.rationale: FIFA Earth association-identity estimate for NCL. 2006 registration and club density anchor organised access; later Forward facilities support system capacity but are not used as a direct mass-access census. The 1–10 value is project-authored; missing professional evidence is never converted to zero.

competition_quality.rationale: FIFA Earth association-identity estimate for NCL. elite_support.rationale: FIFA Earth association-identity estimate for NCL. Federation continuity, FIFA membership and current headquarters/technical-centre/national-team support create a strong modern support context specific to New Caledonia.
